issues: 7.57-7.77s (optional polish): the side-face sheen now peaks at mid or light grey and builds over about 5 frames, so it reads as a travelling reflection, not a strobe. It still drops off within 1-2 frames at frame 232 (mean luma 37.4->27.0, the largest mean change in the film). Widening the falloff of the trailing softbox edge by 3-4 frames would remove the last hint of a snap.

5.8-7.8s (optional): condensation droplets cluster densely on the lit side face, and the dark dots stand out against the sheen. Slightly fewer droplets on the side faces would keep the glass reading cleaner.
0.0-0.03s (minor): the first frame-to-frame step (mean luma change about 5) suggests the opening does not start fully black or eased. A 4-6 frame fade-in from black would hide it.
Cap (minor): the vertical highlight bands still read faintly fluted at 3.5-7s. Optionally merge them into one broader soft highlight.

Correction to the previous review: the audio peak is -3.05 dBFS per channel (volumedetect max_volume -3.0 dB, mean -15.5 dB). My earlier -0.05 dBFS figure came from summing the channels in a mono downmix and was wrong. Audio is 15.02s long. The loudest transient onset is at 9.00s (largest 50ms RMS rise, +7.4 dB), and the bass rises from 9.00s to a peak at 9.17s. No action needed.
